points.K8: 距离加倍，照射降到四分之一
points.K9: 平方反比的验证与适用范围
points.K10: 每种核素有自己的γ常数

points.K12: 吸收剂量说不清的两件事

points.K22: 组织权重因子分高中低

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一级级发光的台阶前，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a glowing staircase of four steps, colored from orange to teal, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，我们认识辐射剂量。
overlay: 辐射剂量入门：从空气电离到人体风险

shots.scene: 四级台阶上依次亮起空气盒、方块、粒子、人体四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four steps light up one by one with icons on them: a box of air, a solid cube, a group of particles and a simple human body outline. No people.
shots.narration: 从空气里的电离，一步步走到人体风险。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一张空白剂量报告单，挠头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a blank dose report sheet and scratches his head in a lab corridor.
shots.narration: 阿杰刚进放射实验室，看不懂剂量报告。

shots.scene: 阿杰翻开一本旧笔记，看到更多陌生单位，更困惑了
shots.prompt_en: The young male student flips open an old notebook with blank pages and frowns even more, question marks floating above his head.
shots.narration: 旧笔记里还有伦琴、拉德，更糊涂了。

shots.scene: 小研笑着在白板上画出四级台阶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student smiles and draws a simple four-step staircase on a blank whiteboard for the young male student.
shots.narration: 小研说：这些量，其实是一级级台阶。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 要防护辐射，先学会怎么衡量它。

shots.section_title: 健康物理：测量辐射，保护人
shots.scene: 欣欣站在两个交叠的圆圈图标旁，圆圈分别是原子核和原子
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside two overlapping circles: one with an atomic nucleus icon, one with an atom with orbiting electrons.
shots.narration: 健康物理，是核物理和原子物理的交叉。
overlay: 健康物理：测量辐射，保护人

shots.section_title: 健康物理：测量辐射，保护人
shots.scene: 量尺、计算器、盾牌三个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a measuring ruler, a calculator and a shield with a heart on it. No people.
shots.narration: 测量、计算辐射，用来保护人的健康。

shots.section_title: 辐射有利有弊，先学防护
shots.scene: 一把双刃剑图标，一边亮绿一边暗红
shots.prompt_en: A double-edged sword icon, one edge glowing green and the other dark red. No people.
shots.narration: 辐射像一把双刃剑。
overlay: 辐射有利有弊，先学防护

shots.section_title: 辐射有利有弊，先学防护
shots.scene: 发电站、医院病床和医学影像设备图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a power station with a cooling tower, a hospital bed and a medical scanner, each with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 核电发电、医学诊疗，是它的好用途。

shots.section_title: 辐射有利有弊，先学防护
shots.scene: 被红叉划掉的炸弹图标
shots.prompt_en: A cartoon bomb icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 用来做武器，就是坏用途。

shots.section_title: 辐射有利有弊，先学防护
shots.scene: 欣欣举起一面盾牌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a shield with a confident smile.
shots.narration: 想用好辐射，先学会保护自己。

shots.scene: 一束射线穿过一团原子，有的电子被打飞，有的原子发光
shots.prompt_en: A beam of small arrows passes through a cluster of atoms; some electrons are knocked away and some atoms glow briefly. No people.
shots.narration: 辐射穿过物质，会电离或激发原子。
overlay: 电离与四级剂量台阶

shots.scene: 计数器图标和电池能量图标并排
shots.prompt_en: A tally counter icon next to a battery energy icon. No people.
shots.narration: 剂量单位，要么数电离，要么算能量。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在四级台阶的最下面一级，抬头往上看
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands on the lowest of four glowing steps and looks up toward the top step.
shots.narration: 这一课，我们一级一级往上走。

shots.scene: 一个透明空气盒，射线穿过后盒内出现许多正负小球
shots.prompt_en: A transparent box filled with air; X-ray and gamma ray arrows pass through it and many small plus and minus balls appear inside. No people.
shots.narration: 第一级是照射量，只看空气里的电离。
overlay: 照射量：空气里的电离

shots.scene: 两种射线图标打勾，其他粒子图标灰色
shots.prompt_en: Two wavy-line ray icons glow with green check marks, while particle icons beside them are greyed out. No people.
shots.narration: 而且只针对X射线和γ射线。

shots.scene: 空气盒里只把正号小球装进一个篮子称数量
shots.prompt_en: Only the plus-sign balls from the air box are scooped into a small basket and counted. No people.
shots.narration: 只数一种符号的电荷，再除以空气质量。

shots.scene: 被打出的电子在盒内绕几圈后停下，没有跑出盒外
shots.prompt_en: Small electron dots inside the air box travel short curvy paths and stop before reaching the walls. No people.
shots.narration: 打出的电子，要在空气里完全停下来。

shots.scene: 一个干燥空气盒和一个带水珠的潮湿空气盒并排，中间问号
shots.prompt_en: A dry air box and a humid air box with water droplets side by side, a question mark between them. No people.
shots.narration: 空气干湿不同，结果也会不同。

shots.scene: 空气盒旁一个电荷图标除以一个秤的图标
shots.prompt_en: An electric charge icon above a scale icon with a horizontal line between them, next to an air box. No people.
shots.narration: 照射量的国际单位，是库仑每千克。
overlay: 照射量的单位

shots.scene: 一本泛黄的旧书上画着空气盒图标
shots.prompt_en: An old yellowed book with an air box icon on its cover. No people.
shots.narration: 历史单位叫伦琴，现在仍会见到。

shots.scene: 旧书和新单位之间一个等号天平
shots.prompt_en: An old book icon and a modern unit card balanced on a small scale with an equals sign. No people.
shots.narration: 一伦琴约等于万分之二点五八库仑每千克。

shots.scene: 一立方厘米的小空气方块里出现一份电荷
shots.prompt_en: A tiny cube of air, one centimeter on each side, with a small glowing charge icon appearing inside it. No people.
shots.narration: 最初按每立方厘米空气产生的电荷定义。

shots.scene: 从简单的方块积木到复杂的积木塔
shots.prompt_en: A single simple building block grows step by step into a more complex block tower. No people.
shots.narration: 先从最简单的空气讲起，再推广。

shots.section_title: 电离一对离子要多少能量
shots.scene: 一个小锤子敲开一对正负小球，旁边是能量计量表
shots.prompt_en: A small hammer splits an atom into a plus ball and a minus ball, with an energy meter icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 在空气里打出一对离子，要花固定能量。
overlay: 电离一对离子要多少能量

shots.section_title: 电离一对离子要多少能量
shots.scene: 离子对计数器和能量表用双向箭头连起来
shots.prompt_en: A tally counter of ion pairs and an energy meter connected by a two-way arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 数清离子对，就能换算出沉积的能量。

shots.section_title: 电离一对离子要多少能量
shots.scene: 空气盒旁一个换算箭头指向能量方块
shots.prompt_en: An air box icon with a conversion arrow pointing to a small energy cube. No people.
shots.narration: 折算下来，一伦琴约相当于0.877拉德。

shots.scene: 空气盒打勾，组织块打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two panels: a transparent air box with a green check mark, and a teal tissue block with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 但照射量只管空气，管不了人体。
overlay: 照射量的局限

shots.scene: 中子、α、β、重离子图标被挡在门外
shots.prompt_en: Icons of neutrons, alpha particles, beta particles and heavy ions stand outside a small gate that is closed. No people.
shots.narration: 中子、α、β这些粒子，它也不适用。

shots.scene: 人体、水杯、铅砖三个图标，上方问号
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a human body outline, a glass of water and a lead brick, with a question mark above them. No people.
shots.narration: 人体、水、屏蔽材料，需要新的量。

shots.section_title: 距离加倍，照射降到四分之一
shots.scene: 一个小灯泡点源，光线照到近处小方框和远处大方框
shots.prompt_en: A tiny glowing point source sends straight rays to a small square nearby and a square four times larger twice as far away. No people.
shots.narration: 射线从点源向四面散开。
overlay: 距离加倍，照射降到四分之一

shots.section_title: 距离加倍，照射降到四分之一
shots.scene: 一只时钟和一个照射计量表并排
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon next to a radiation gauge icon, with an arrow showing the gauge reading per hour. No people.
shots.narration: 单位时间的照射量叫照射量率，常用伦琴每小时。

shots.section_title: 距离加倍，照射降到四分之一
shots.scene: 洒水壶在近处浇一小块地很湿，远处浇一大片地只有几滴
shots.prompt_en: A watering can sprays water: close up it soaks a small patch, farther away the same water spreads thin over a large area. No people.
shots.narration: 就像浇花，离得越远，水洒得越稀。

shots.section_title: 距离加倍，照射降到四分之一
shots.scene: 距离标尺上从1到2，旁边剂量条从4格降到1格
shots.prompt_en: A distance ruler marked one to two, next to a bar that drops from four blocks to one block. No people.
shots.narration: 距离加倍，照射率降到四分之一。

shots.section_title: 距离加倍，照射降到四分之一
shots.scene: 老李用长柄工具远远夹取一个铅罐图标
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer uses long-handled tongs to move a small lead container while standing well back from it, wearing a lab coat and gloves.
shots.narration: 拉开距离，是最有效的防护之一。

shots.section_title: 距离加倍，照射降到四分之一
shots.scene: 一面厚墙挡住射线箭头
shots.prompt_en: A thick wall blocks a row of ray arrows coming from a small source. No people.
shots.narration: 厚厚的屏蔽，也能挡住射线。

shots.section_title: 平方反比的验证与适用范围
shots.scene: 小研在实验台上移动计数器，离一个小铅罐越来越远
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing a lab coat, gloves and a dosimeter badge, slides a radiation counter farther from a small lead container along a ruler on the bench.
shots.narration: 实验课上，用GM计数器改变距离计数验证。
overlay: 平方反比的验证与适用范围

shots.section_title: 平方反比的验证与适用范围
shots.scene: 计数器空白屏幕旁的柱状图逐渐降低
shots.prompt_en: A radiation counter with a blank display beside a bar chart whose bars drop quickly as the distance grows. No people.
shots.narration: 距离越远，计数掉得越快。

shots.section_title: 平方反比的验证与适用范围
shots.scene: 一个点光源打勾，一块大面板光源旁边是问号
shots.prompt_en: A tiny point source with a green check mark, and a large flat glowing panel source with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 但这只适用于点源；大面积源更复杂。

shots.section_title: 每种核素有自己的γ常数
shots.scene: 四个不同颜色的小瓶，每个瓶上方有不同亮度的光芒
shots.prompt_en: Four small vials of different colors with blank labels, each giving off rays of different brightness. No people.
shots.narration: 每种放射性核素，射线强弱各不同。
overlay: 每种核素有自己的γ常数

shots.section_title: 每种核素有自己的γ常数
shots.scene: 每个小瓶旁一张空白身份证卡片
shots.prompt_en: Each vial has a blank identity card next to it. No people.
shots.narration: γ常数就像核素的身份证。

shots.section_title: 每种核素有自己的γ常数
shots.scene: 活度旋钮调高、距离调远，剂量表指针随之变化
shots.prompt_en: Two dials, one for source strength turned up and one for distance turned up, with a gauge needle moving in response. No people.
shots.narration: 活度越大越强，距离越远越弱。

shots.section_title: 每种核素有自己的γ常数
shots.scene: 一个计算器图标：γ常数乘活度，除以距离平方
shots.prompt_en: A calculator icon with a vial icon, a distance ruler icon and a gauge icon connected by arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 照射率等于γ常数乘活度，除以距离平方。

shots.section_title: 每种核素有自己的γ常数
shots.scene: 四个小瓶下方一张数值表
shots.prompt_en: Four small vials with blank labels stand above a simple table with four rows of blank cells. No people.

shots.section_title: 每种核素有自己的γ常数
shots.scene: 射线撞上电子，电子弹开一路留下离子
shots.prompt_en: A ray arrow bumps into an electron, which recoils and leaves a trail of small ions behind it. No people.
shots.narration: 空气里的电离，主要靠被撞飞的电子。

shots.section_title: 吸收剂量：物质吸收的能量
shots.scene: 阳光照在一杯水上，水杯逐渐变暖发红
shots.prompt_en: Sunlight rays shine on a glass of water, which slowly glows warm orange. No people.
shots.narration: 第二级是吸收剂量，看物质吸收的能量。
overlay: 吸收剂量：物质吸收的能量

shots.section_title: 吸收剂量：物质吸收的能量
shots.scene: 能量块放在一千克方块上
shots.prompt_en: An energy block icon sitting on top of a one-kilogram cube icon. No people.
shots.narration: 每千克物质吸收一焦耳，就是一戈瑞。

shots.section_title: 吸收剂量：物质吸收的能量
shots.scene: 任意材料块和各种射线图标都打勾
shots.prompt_en: A wooden block, a water cube and a tissue block, each hit by different ray icons, all with green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 它适用于任何辐射、任何物质。

shots.section_title: 吸收剂量：物质吸收的能量
shots.scene: 旧书上写着旧单位图标，旁边换算箭头
shots.prompt_en: An old book icon beside a new book icon with a conversion arrow between them. No people.
shots.narration: 旧单位拉德，一戈瑞等于一百拉德。

shots.section_title: 吸收剂量说不清的两件事
shots.scene: 一个装满水的杯子，旁边一个打问号的时钟
shots.prompt_en: A full glass of water next to a clock with a question mark on it. No people.
shots.narration: 可吸收剂量说不清照得有多快。
overlay: 吸收剂量说不清的两件事

shots.section_title: 吸收剂量说不清的两件事
shots.scene: 同样满的杯子，旁边一个打问号的射线种类图标
shots.prompt_en: The same full glass next to a question mark over several different ray type icons. No people.
shots.narration: 也说不清是哪种辐射照的。

shots.section_title: 吸收剂量说不清的两件事
shots.scene: 欣欣举起时钟和射线两张卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up two blank cards, one with a clock icon and one with a ray icon.
shots.narration: 这两点，偏偏对生物效应很重要。

shots.section_title: 照射量与组织剂量的换算
shots.scene: 空气盒与软组织块之间一座小桥
shots.prompt_en: A small bridge connects a transparent air box to a soft tissue block. No people.
shots.narration: 对软组织，照射量能换算成吸收剂量。
overlay: 照射量与组织剂量的换算

shots.section_title: 照射量与组织剂量的换算
shots.scene: 桥上一个几乎等于1的小系数卡片，随能量轻微变化
shots.prompt_en: A blank card on the bridge with a small slider that moves slightly as an energy dial turns. No people.
shots.narration: 系数f约0.93到0.97拉德每伦琴。

shots.scene: 两个人体轮廓，左边橙色雾气均匀散开，右边胸口一个集中的深色斑
shots.prompt_en: Two simple human body outlines: on the left a light orange haze spreads evenly, on the right a small dark concentrated spot sits on the chest. No people.
shots.narration: 同样一戈瑞，α和γ伤害一样吗？
overlay: 同样1戈瑞，伤害不一样

shots.scene: 右边的深色斑上出现警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A yellow warning triangle appears over the dark concentrated spot on the right figure. No people.
shots.narration: α造成的伤害，要大得多。

shots.scene: 欣欣摇头，旁边两个等号被划掉
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot shakes its head beside an equals sign that is crossed out with a red X.
shots.narration: 吸收剂量相同，生物效应不一定相同。

shots.scene: 两把尺子比较达到同一伤害需要的剂量
shots.prompt_en: Two bars reach the same target line, one long bar for the reference ray and one short bar for alpha. No people.
shots.narration: 达到同样效果所需剂量之比，叫相对生物效应。

shots.section_title: 传能线密度：密集还是稀疏
shots.scene: 细雨稀稀落落打在一条DNA梯子上，只有一两处小缺口
shots.prompt_en: Light drizzle falls sparsely on a DNA ladder, leaving only one or two small nicks. No people.
shots.narration: γ射线像毛毛雨，能量洒得稀疏。
overlay: 传能线密度：密集还是稀疏

shots.section_title: 传能线密度：密集还是稀疏
shots.scene: 小剪刀和胶带修补DNA缺口
shots.prompt_en: Tiny cartoon repair tools patch the small nicks on the DNA ladder back together. No people.
shots.narration: 损伤简单，细胞多能修好。

shots.section_title: 传能线密度：密集还是稀疏
shots.scene: 一个保龄球沿短路径冲过DNA梯子，把梯子打成多段碎片
shots.prompt_en: A heavy bowling ball rolls along a short path through a DNA ladder and breaks it into several clustered pieces. No people.
shots.narration: α粒子像保龄球，路径短，砸得密。

shots.section_title: 传能线密度：密集还是稀疏
shots.scene: 修补工具对着碎片无从下手，旁边红叉
shots.prompt_en: The tiny repair tools hover helplessly over the broken pieces, with a red X nearby. No people.
shots.narration: 成簇的断裂，细胞很难修好。

shots.section_title: 传能线密度：密集还是稀疏
shots.scene: 一条路径上的能量点，稀疏和密集两种对比
shots.prompt_en: Two paths side by side: one with sparse energy dots, one packed with dense energy dots, with a short ruler under each. No people.
shots.narration: 单位路程沉积的能量，叫传能线密度。

shots.section_title: 传能线密度：密集还是稀疏
shots.scene: 欣欣指着密集那条路径
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the path packed with dense energy dots.
shots.narration: 电离越密集，生物损伤越大。

shots.section_title: 相对生物效应不是固定值
shots.scene: 多个旋钮图标：细胞、剂量、时钟、组织
shots.prompt_en: Four dials labeled with icons: a cell, a dose cup, a clock and a tissue block, each turning. No people.
shots.narration: 相对生物效应，会随许多条件变化。
overlay: 相对生物效应不是固定值

shots.section_title: 相对生物效应不是固定值
shots.scene: 一摞档案盒和放大镜
shots.prompt_en: A stack of archive boxes with a magnifying glass on top. No people.
shots.narration: 人类数据多来自核爆幸存者和核事故。

shots.section_title: 相对生物效应不是固定值
shots.scene: 一只手推开一份空白自愿表格，旁边红叉
shots.prompt_en: A hand pushes away a blank volunteer form, with a red X beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 没有人会自愿受照来做实验。

shots.section_title: 相对生物效应不是固定值
shots.scene: 阿杰举手提问，旁边一条血管里流动着小红点
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises his hand in a classroom; beside him a simple drawing of a blood vessel with small red dots flowing along it.
shots.narration: 阿杰问：受损的DNA会随血液流动吗？

shots.section_title: 相对生物效应不是固定值
shots.scene: 欣欣点头回答，身旁人体轮廓里血管亮起
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods and answers, standing beside a human body outline whose blood vessels light up.
shots.narration: 欣欣答：可能会随血液带到全身。

shots.scene: 很多条弯曲的数据曲线汇成一个箭头，指向一张空白表格
shots.prompt_en: Many wiggly data curves merge into one big arrow pointing at a neat blank table. No people.
shots.narration: 国际放射防护委员会定了固定、保守的权重。
overlay: 辐射权重因子

shots.scene: 汇率牌：不同货币换成同一种
shots.prompt_en: A currency exchange board: different coin icons convert into the same type of coin. No people.
shots.narration: 辐射权重因子，像不同货币的汇率。

shots.scene: 光子和电子图标旁一个小砝码，α粒子旁一大堆砝码
shots.prompt_en: A photon icon and an electron icon each with one small weight; an alpha particle icon with a tall stack of weights. No people.
shots.narration: 光子、电子、μ子算一倍，α粒子二十倍。

shots.scene: 中子图标旁一条起伏的曲线
shots.prompt_en: A neutron icon beside a smooth curve that rises and falls with energy. No people.
shots.narration: 中子在十万到两百万电子伏时最高，为二十。

shots.scene: 质子图标旁一个小砝码堆
shots.prompt_en: A proton icon with a small stack of weights beside it and an energy arrow pointing up. No people.
shots.narration: 质子在两兆电子伏以上，取五。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起写着问号的卡片，旁边是实验数据图表
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a card with a question mark, next to a simple chart of experimental data points.
shots.narration: 为什么是二十？来自对人体作用的研究。

shots.scene: 安全吗？时间、距离、剂量三个图标都要看
shots.prompt_en: A question mark in the center, surrounded by a clock icon, a distance ruler icon and a dose cup icon. No people.
shots.narration: 安不安全，还要算时间和距离。

shots.scene: 两张卡片并排，一张画射线，一张画器官
shots.prompt_en: Two blank cards side by side, one with ray icons and one with organ icons. No people.
shots.narration: 权重因子有两种，都没有单位。
overlay: 两种权重因子的异同

shots.scene: 两张卡片都把一个戈瑞方块转成希沃特方块
shots.prompt_en: Both cards turn a plain cube into a shield-shaped risk cube through a small machine. No people.
shots.narration: 都把吸收剂量，换算成反映风险的剂量。

shots.scene: 射线卡片箭头指向一个器官，器官卡片箭头指向全身
shots.prompt_en: The ray card points to a single organ; the organ card points to a whole body outline. No people.
shots.narration: 一个管辐射类型，一个管器官敏感性。

shots.scene: 一个器官的平均剂量方块乘以汇率卡片
shots.prompt_en: An average dose cube for one organ passes through an exchange-rate card machine. No people.
shots.narration: 器官的平均吸收剂量，乘上辐射权重。
overlay: 当量剂量与希沃特

shots.scene: 多种射线分别换算后叠成一摞
shots.prompt_en: Several kinds of ray icons each pass through the machine and their outputs stack into one pile. No people.
shots.narration: 几种辐射一起照，分别算再相加。

shots.scene: 一个人体轮廓图标上方写有空白单位卡
shots.prompt_en: A human body outline with a blank unit card floating above it. No people.
shots.narration: 单位希沃特，一希沃特等于一百雷姆。

shots.scene: 两个人体轮廓，α与γ都换成同样大小的风险方块
shots.prompt_en: Two body outlines, one hit by alpha and one by gamma, now show risk cubes of exactly the same size. No people.
shots.narration: 一希沃特α和一希沃特γ，效果相当。

shots.scene: 一台测量仪对着戈瑞打勾，对着希沃特打问号
shots.prompt_en: A measuring instrument with a green check over the plain dose cube and a question mark over the risk cube. No people.
shots.narration: 吸收剂量能测，当量剂量要算出来。

shots.scene: 人体轮廓里器官亮度不同，有的很亮有的暗
shots.prompt_en: A human body outline with organs glowing at different brightness, some bright and some dim. No people.
shots.narration: 身体各个器官，对辐射敏感程度不同。
overlay: 器官敏感性各不相同

shots.scene: 快速分裂的细胞图标和慢慢不动的细胞图标对比
shots.prompt_en: A cell icon dividing rapidly into many cells next to a cell icon that stays still. No people.
shots.narration: 细胞分裂越快，往往越敏感。

shots.scene: 结肠图标风险条高，皮肤图标风险条低
shots.prompt_en: A colon icon with a tall risk bar next to a skin icon with a short risk bar, both receiving the same small dose cup. No people.
shots.narration: 一百毫希照结肠，比照皮肤风险高得多。

shots.scene: 性腺图标亮红，皮肤图标暗淡
shots.prompt_en: A body outline where the gonad area glows bright red and the skin outline stays dim. No people.
shots.narration: 性腺也远比皮肤敏感。

shots.scene: 局部照射的人体，拼图碎片要拼成一个整体
shots.prompt_en: A body outline with only some parts highlighted, puzzle pieces flying together into one whole piece. No people.
shots.narration: 局部照射，需要一个全身风险的总数。

shots.section_title: 有效剂量：全身风险一个数
shots.scene: 老师计算加权总评的图标：各科成绩乘系数相加
shots.prompt_en: Report card icons with different subject icons, each multiplied by a weight and summed into one final score. No people.
shots.narration: 有效剂量，就像按学分算的总评。
overlay: 有效剂量：全身风险一个数

shots.section_title: 有效剂量：全身风险一个数
shots.scene: 各器官的当量剂量方块按权重加总成一个大方块
shots.prompt_en: Small dose cubes from different organs, each scaled by a weight, combine into one big cube beside a body outline. No people.
shots.narration: 各器官当量剂量，按敏感性加权相加。

shots.section_title: 有效剂量：全身风险一个数
shots.scene: 大方块旁边一条致癌风险曲线
shots.prompt_en: The big cube next to a simple rising risk line with a cell icon. No people.
shots.narration: 它和致癌等风险的关系更紧密。

shots.section_title: 有效剂量：全身风险一个数
shots.scene: 测量仪对着大方块打红叉，计算器打勾
shots.prompt_en: A measuring instrument with a red X and a calculator with a green check mark, both pointing at the big cube. No people.
shots.narration: 有效剂量是算出来的，仪器测不出。

shots.section_title: 有效剂量：全身风险一个数
shots.scene: 王老师指着空白的限值标尺
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at a blank vertical limit ruler on a whiteboard.
shots.narration: 它用于防护优化和剂量限值管理。

shots.section_title: 组织权重因子分高中低
shots.scene: 器官分成高、中、低三排的空白表格
shots.prompt_en: A blank three-row table with organ icons sorted into high, medium and low rows. No people.
shots.narration: 器官按风险高低，分成三档。
overlay: 组织权重因子分高中低

shots.section_title: 组织权重因子分高中低
shots.scene: 高风险一排亮起：骨髓、结肠、肺、胃、乳腺图标
shots.prompt_en: The high row of the table lights up with icons of bone marrow, colon, lungs, stomach and breast. No people.
shots.narration: 高档有骨髓、结肠、肺、胃和乳腺。

shots.section_title: 组织权重因子分高中低
shots.scene: 中风险一排亮起：性腺、膀胱、肝、甲状腺图标
shots.prompt_en: The middle row lights up with icons of gonads, bladder, liver and thyroid. No people.
shots.narration: 中档有性腺、膀胱、肝和甲状腺。

shots.section_title: 组织权重因子分高中低
shots.scene: 低风险一排亮起：骨表面、脑、皮肤、唾液腺图标
shots.prompt_en: The low row lights up with icons of bone surface, brain, skin and salivary glands. No people.
shots.narration: 低档有骨表面、脑、皮肤和唾液腺。

shots.section_title: 组织权重因子分高中低
shots.scene: 一块饼图被分成多块，合起来是一个整圆
shots.prompt_en: A pie chart divided into slices of different sizes that together form one whole circle. No people.
shots.narration: 所有组织权重加起来，正好是一。

shots.section_title: 组织权重因子分高中低
shots.scene: 一个胃部图标旁有很多原因图标，射线只是其一
shots.prompt_en: A stomach icon surrounded by many cause icons such as food, genes and a ray icon. No people.
shots.narration: 得了胃癌，不能就断定是辐射引起。

shots.section_title: 组织权重因子分高中低
shots.scene: 教室里一个学生接到电话突然离开座位
shots.prompt_en: In a classroom, the young male student gets a phone call and suddenly leaves his seat without a word.
shots.narration: 辐射会让细胞像突然离场的学生。

shots.section_title: 组织权重因子分高中低
shots.scene: 一个细胞图标行为失常，偏离队列
shots.prompt_en: A row of tidy cell icons, one of them turning odd and wandering out of line. No people.
shots.narration: 细胞行为失常，可能就是癌变开端。

shots.scene: 欣欣从台阶底部一级级走上去
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot climbs the four glowing steps one by one.
shots.narration: 我们把四级台阶连起来看。
overlay: 四级台阶回顾

shots.scene: 第一级空气盒亮起
shots.prompt_en: The first step with the air box icon lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 照射量：射线在空气里的电离。

shots.scene: 第二级方块亮起
shots.prompt_en: The second step with the solid cube icon lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 吸收剂量：物质吸收的能量，戈瑞。

shots.scene: 第三级粒子图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: The third step with the particle icons lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 当量剂量：再看辐射类型，希沃特。

shots.scene: 第四级人体图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: The fourth step with the human body outline lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 有效剂量：再看器官敏感，希沃特。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在顶层，身后是整座台阶
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands proudly on the top step with the whole staircase behind it.
shots.narration: 后一级，都建在前一级的基础上。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现四级台阶图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a small floating four-step staircase icon.
shots.narration: 照射、吸收、当量、有效，逐级建立。
overlay: 小结

shots.scene: α保龄球和γ细雨图标并排
shots.prompt_en: A bowling ball icon and a light drizzle icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 同样戈瑞，辐射种类不同，伤害不同。

shots.scene: 器官亮度不同的人体轮廓
shots.prompt_en: A body outline with organs glowing at different brightness. No people.
shots.narration: 器官敏感不同，有效剂量看全身。

shots.scene: 两张权重卡片：射线和器官
shots.prompt_en: Two blank cards with green check marks, one with ray icons and one with organ icons. No people.
shots.narration: 辐射权重管种类，组织权重管器官。

shots.scene: 距离尺和厚墙两个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons with green check marks: a distance ruler and a thick wall. No people.
shots.narration: 距离加倍照射降四倍，屏蔽也能挡。

shots.scene: 欣欣在台阶顶上挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera from the top of the glowing staircase.
shots.narration: 懂了剂量，才能用好辐射！
